verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos and eat Death's Grasp into Obliterate; you win if you poke with Q, hold Grievous Wounds, and let the lane go long.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser's whole kit is built to force a short-range fight he wins — Death's Grasp (E) drags you into Obliterate (Q) range, and Indestructible (W) banks every point of damage from that exchange into a self-heal. Malphite has no reliable way to punish him at range, so the matchup is decided by whether you keep trades on your terms (Seismic Shard pokes, then back off) or let him dictate them with his pull.

theirWindow.when: After he lands Q or two autos on you
theirWindow.what: He's one more hit from Darkness Rise (3 landed attacks/spells) and ready to follow with Death's Grasp into Obliterate. Disengage rather than trade through it — his damage spikes hard once the aura is up.

yourWindow.when: Right after he uses Death's Grasp (E) on minions or whiffs it
yourWindow.what: E is down for 16/14/12/10/8s depending on his level — step up and land free Seismic Shard (Q) pokes or shove the wave without fear of being pulled.

start.item: Doran's Ring + Health Potion + Health Potion
start.why: 73.7% pick, 46.1% WR over 165 games. The mana and regen let you spam Seismic Shard (Q, 8s cd) to poke and farm without running dry, which is the entire win condition in this lane.

boots.why: 50.7% pick, 45.3% WR over 106 games. Tenacity cuts down how long Death's Grasp holds you in his range, and the magic resist blunts both Obliterate and Death's Grasp since Mordekaiser's whole kit is magic damage.

core.why: Grievous Wounds directly undercuts Indestructible (W) — he can't heal off the shield he banks from your trades if he's cut.
Reapplies Grievous Wounds on hit and stacks armor against his auto-attack-reliant Darkness Rise stacking.
CDR plus an attack speed slow aura that slows down how fast he lands the three hits he needs for his passive.

situational.when: you're behind and need a burst magic shield against his Death's Grasp into Obliterate combo
you're ahead and want wave clear plus a DPS tool for teamfights instead of more peel

runes.keystoneWhy: 54.8% WR on this page over fewer games, but it's the right tool for the matchup: proc healing on your first hit each fight offsets how much sustain Mordekaiser gets back from Indestructible, and it rewards the slow, patient trading this lane demands.

summoners.why: 47.3% WR at 75.3% pick, the clear standard. This is a scaling, farm-first matchup — Teleport lets you reset after shoves and stay relevant for objectives instead of forcing all-ins you lose.

playing.title: Poke with Q, then back off
playing.detail: Seismic Shard (8s cd, 625 range) is your only safe damage source. Land it and immediately retreat out of his 675-range Obliterate instead of staying in to auto-trade.

playing.title: Never feed his passive stacks
playing.detail: Darkness Rise triggers after 3 landed attacks/spells on you and gives him a damage aura plus move speed. Dodge Obliterate when you can and don't stand in extended auto range.

playing.title: Track Death's Grasp, not just his HP
playing.detail: His E (16/14/12/10/8s cd) is the only way he can force you into range. Once it's down on cooldown, that's your window to shove the wave or poke freely.

playing.title: Short trades only, never long ones
playing.detail: Indestructible (W) banks damage from both sides of a fight into a shield he can consume to heal. The longer a fight runs, the more it favors him — hit and leave.

playing.title: Save Unstoppable Force for peel, not engage
playing.detail: Your R (130/115/100/80/80s cd) is a knockup/dash, not a way to win a straight fight into Mordekaiser. Use it to save a teammate he's chasing or punish him overextending after his E is spent.

playing.title: Rush Grievous Wounds if he snowballs
playing.detail: If he gets ahead early, prioritize finishing Hollow Radiance before anything else — it's the direct counter to the sustain Indestructible gives him.

playing.title: Respect Realm of Death from level 6
playing.detail: His ultimate (650 range) drags you into an isolated duel and can permanently steal your stats if it kills you. Don't commit to trades near brush or river where he can flash in and land it low.

brief.patchCaveat: Build, runes, summoners, and all win rates/pick rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (180 games sampled for this matchup); the mechanical reasoning and trade-pattern advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Avoid fighting Mordekaiser head on as well as being pulled by his (E). Use [Q] to focus on contesting and farming lane.
